summary: The Base64 regressions are explained by incorrect bit shifts in both tail encoders and the unescape decoder. The supplied implementations and contracts identify the affected one-byte and two-byte paths, including padded and unpadded inputs; the current validation reproduces both failing test groups.
hypotheses: The one-byte encoder tail shifts the remaining bits by 3 instead of 4, and the two-byte tail shifts them by 1 instead of 2.
The decoder shifts leftover two-character input by 5 instead of 4 and three-character input by 3 instead of 2, corrupting one- and two-byte results.
